from datetime import datetime

# Branch results from previous step
hahn_interval = "2013-01-01 to 2017-01-01"
shackell_interval = "2012-01-01 to 2015-01-01"

# Parse André Hahn dates
hahn_start_str, hahn_end_str = hahn_interval.split(" to ")
hahn_start = datetime.strptime(hahn_start_str.strip(), "%Y-%m-%d")
hahn_end = datetime.strptime(hahn_end_str.strip(), "%Y-%m-%d")

# Parse Jason Shackell dates
shackell_start_str, shackell_end_str = shackell_interval.split(" to ")
shackell_start = datetime.strptime(shackell_start_str.strip(), "%Y-%m-%d")
shackell_end = datetime.strptime(shackell_end_str.strip(), "%Y-%m-%d")

print(f"André Hahn (Bundestag): {hahn_start.date()} to {hahn_end.date()}")
print(f"Jason Shackell (Burnley): {shackell_start.date()} to {shackell_end.date()}")

# Calculate intersection (overlap)
overlap_start = max(hahn_start, shackell_start)
overlap_end = min(hahn_end, shackell_end)

print(f"\nOverlap period: {overlap_start.date()} to {overlap_end.date()}")

# Format as tuple
tuple_str = f"({overlap_start.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}, {overlap_end.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')})"
print(tuple_str)
